edges.reason: Owned constructor reads msg.sender to initialize owner.
owner state variable is assigned from msg.sender in the constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership body executes.
transferOwnership consumes the _newOwner parameter.
_newOwner value is written into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to authorize the handover.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, transferring privileged control.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner back to address(0).
EVATOKEN constructor sets the symbol state variable.
EVATOKEN constructor sets the name state variable.
EVATOKEN constructor sets the decimals state variable.
EVATOKEN constructor sets _totalSupply to a fixed mint amount.
EVATOKEN constructor writes the whole supply into balances of a hardcoded address.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
balanceOf uses tokenOwner parameter as the mapping key.
transfer debits the balances entry of msg.sender.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer relies on safeSub for the sender balance decrement.
transfer relies on safeAdd for the recipient balance increment.
tokens parameter determines the transferred amount in transfer.
to parameter identifies the transfer recipient.
tokens parameter is forwarded to safeSub.
tokens parameter is forwarded to safeAdd.
approve grants an allowance on behalf of msg.sender.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approve.
tokens parameter is used as the allowance value in approve.
transferFrom debits the allowance granted to msg.sender.
transferFrom updates account balances.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient balance increment.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter keys the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in allowance.
approveAndCall sets the allowance on behalf of msg.sender.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping.
spender parameter selects the contract to call and approve.
tokens parameter is the approved amount.
data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-supplied spender contract.
The externally called spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall while state is mid-update.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before transferAnyERC20Token executes.
owner address is the destination of the swept tokens.
tokenAddress parameter selects an arbitrary external contract to call.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
The external token contract can call back into transferAnyERC20Token during execution.
